observations.behavior: Adds 'workflows' to the list of billable AI products alongside Slack and PostHog Code.
observations.posthog_connection: This change registers workflows as an eligible product for billing against PostHog AI credits rather than code credits.

observations.behavior: Defines a new workflow configuration with OAuth-only access, shared model policy, and server-minted credentials. No API keys allowed; must use app-specific OAuth tokens.
observations.posthog_connection: Establishes authentication and permission boundaries for workflows, preventing users from bypassing tier restrictions via personal API keys or unauthenticated requests.

observations.behavior: Adds tests asserting that workflow-originated runs receive a pinned sandbox token when routed through the gateway, while rejecting user-supplied values.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides regression protection and behavioral checks for the credential pinning mechanism used by workflows in production execution paths.

observations.limitations: All hunks are additions without removals; no rollback behavior is shown. The patch does not demonstrate end-to-end runtime behavior, only registration and auth-policy setup. No adoption or incident-avoidance metrics are supplied.

review.limitations: All hunks are additions without removals; no rollback behavior is shown. The patch does not demonstrate end-to-end runtime behavior, only registration and auth-policy setup. No adoption or incident-avoidance metrics are supplied.
review.reason: The implementation adds a bounded capability: registering workflows as a billable agent product with its own OAuth-backed identity and shared-but-restricted model set. This changes billing attribution and credential requirements, which could affect PostHog’s revenue accounting and security posture if misconfigured. Tests support this change but do not establish broader systemic benefit.
review.posthog_relevance: Relevant to billing correctness and access control for an AI-driven workflow feature. Could prevent account-level overage or unauthorized premium-model use if authentication enforcement fails.
review.uncertainty: No live deployment or compatibility test results accompany these configuration and policy updates. Grouping issue false; all hunks share consistent intent around workflows.
